solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: City theatre toured by Duke of Edinburgh award's chief

indicators.note: a theatre toured by someone has that person going all round it, so these letters wrap the theatre

parts.note: Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh, shortened to his familiar name Phil

indicators.note: the chief part of a word here is its leading letter

parts.note: the Adelphi is a theatre on London's Strand

explanation.surface: A city theatre is visited by students doing the Duke of Edinburgh's award scheme, led by its head.
explanation.walkthrough: The Adelphi is a West End theatre on London's Strand; Prince Philip's familiar short name supplies the outer piece, completed by the head of 'award's'.
explanation.definitionFit: Philadelphia is a major city in Pennsylvania, USA.

clue.text: Liked tree cut centrally, in the middle

indicators.note: in the middle says the central letter is placed inside the tree's name

parts.note: the poplar is a tall, fast-growing tree

indicators.note: centrally points to the letter at the very centre of the word cut

explanation.surface: A well-liked tree has been pruned through its middle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'centrally' picks U, the middle letter of 'cut', and 'in the middle' puts it inside POPLAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Something widely liked is popular; the adjective swaps directly for the participle used adjectivally.

clue.text: See 15
In siege and massacre, desperate in the extreme

parts.note: the Alamo in Texas was besieged in 1836 and its defenders massacred

indicators.note: in the extreme points to the outermost letters, the first and last, of desperate

explanation.surface: A desperate scene inside a siege and massacre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' is the definition in its sense of fashionable, not a container signal. 'in the extreme' gives D and E, the ends of 'desperate'.
explanation.definitionFit: Fashionable or trendy things are 'in', and the borrowed French phrase likewise means in current style.

clue.text: Polled Henry Abraham into New Labour

indicators.note: New signals the letters are made into a new arrangement, playing on the party name New Labour
polled means having had the head cut off, so the first letter of Henry goes

explanation.surface: Henry and Abraham were polled before joining the New Labour party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polled' takes the head off HENRY, leaving ENRY; 'New' rearranges ENRY + ABRAHAM + INTO. 'Labour' is not the party but one of the twelve labours of Hercules.
explanation.definitionFit: Capturing the wild beast of Mount Erymanthus was the fourth of the twelve tasks Hercules was set.

clue.text: Thick oil used specifically in locks

definitions.text: Thick oil used specifically in locks

parts.words: Thick oil used specifically in locks
parts.note: locks suggests the keyholes of doors needing grease, but here means hair

explanation.surface: A heavy lubricant is reserved for the locks on a door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'locks' tempts a solver towards door hardware; it means tresses of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: Pomade is a scented greasy dressing combed through hair to hold it in place.

clue.text: Vindictive outsiders penetrating web, mostly separate

indicators.note: penetrating means pushing into, so these letters go inside the other piece
mostly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: the web is the internet

indicators.note: outsiders points to the outer letters, first and last, of vindictive

explanation.surface: Vindictive people from outside are breaking into the web and should mostly be kept apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'separate' is a verb here, not an adjective: to step in and part two sides.
explanation.definitionFit: To intervene is to come between two parties, as one does to separate fighters.

clue.text: Current deviants, very forward venomous types

indicators.note: forward says the letter standing for very is moved to the front

parts.note: I is the physics symbol for electric current
pervs, short for perverts, are sexual deviants

explanation.surface: Electric currents, deviants and very pushy venomous creatures.
explanation.walkthrough: I + PERVS gives IPERVS; 'very forward' moves its V to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Vipers are poisonous snakes, the plural matching 'types'.

clue.text: Stone in case, whitish on the interior

definitions.text: Stone in case, whitish on the interior

parts.words: Stone in case, whitish on the interior
parts.note: describes a gem of milky white colouring set in a jewellery case

explanation.surface: A gemstone kept in its box, pale-hued inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Opal is a gemstone typically milky white with flashes of colour.

clue.text: Unlike X and Y, Z is so irregular

definitions.text: Unlike X and Y, Z is so irregular

parts.words: Unlike X and Y, Z is so irregular
parts.note: capital X and Y each have a mirror line, while Z has none, read as letter shapes rather than algebra

explanation.surface: An algebra problem where variable Z behaves unlike X and Y.
explanation.walkthrough: X, Y and Z look like algebraic unknowns; the clue is about the shapes of the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Irregular, lacking balance between halves, is the meaning of lacking mirror symmetry.

clue.text: Expect to watch it at a reduced rate

definitions.text: Expect to watch it at a reduced rate

parts.words: Expect to watch it at a reduced rate
parts.note: reduced rate hints at a cheap discount but means film played back more slowly

explanation.surface: A cut-price offer to view something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced rate' suggests a cheap ticket; it is a lower playback speed.
explanation.definitionFit: Slow motion footage is replayed more slowly than real time, as in sports replays.

clue.text: Tree, a thing around an island

parts.note: the alder is a tree of damp ground

indicators.note: around means turned round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: to have a thing for something is to have a yen, a longing

explanation.surface: A tree and some object encircling an isle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' looks like a container signal but here means turned round; 'a thing' is the yen of 'having a thing for'.
explanation.definitionFit: Alderney is one of the Channel Islands, between England and France.

clue.text: Tom found father

parts.note: tom is slang for a prostitute, shortened to pro
to found something is to create or establish it

explanation.surface: Tom tracked down his dad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tom' looks like a name; it is slang for a prostitute. 'father' is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To father a child is to beget offspring, the verb sense of producing young.

clue.text: Stop old film director taking lid off beans

parts.note: can is a verb meaning stop, as in 'can it'

indicators.note: taking the lid off means removing the top, the first letter

parts.note: Federico Fellini was the Italian director of La Dolce Vita

explanation.surface: A command to halt an old film director's habit of opening tins of beans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking lid off' drops the F from FELLINI.
explanation.definitionFit: Cannellini are white Italian kidney beans, the plural noun matching 'beans'.

clue.text: Unwrapped chilled refreshments

indicators.note: unwrapped means the outer letters are stripped away

parts.note: chilled out, relaxed, is to be at ease

explanation.surface: Cold drinks served without their packaging.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chilled' is not cold but relaxed: AT EASE, with its outer A and E removed.
explanation.definitionFit: Teas are afternoon drinks and snacks, a common British sense of refreshment.

clue.text: Semi-reclusive female

indicators.note: semi means half, here the first half of the word

parts.note: monastic life is withdrawn and reclusive

explanation.surface: A woman who is partly a hermit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Semi-' halves MONASTIC, keeping its first four letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Mona is a woman's given name, so it stands for a female in crossword use.

clue.text: While matron's working, she's expected to be harsh

indicators.note: working means put into action and reshaped, so these letters get a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A matron on duty is expected to be stern.
explanation.walkthrough: 'matron's' is matron is: 'working' rearranges WHILE MATRON.
explanation.definitionFit: The harsh spouse's parent is a stock figure of comedy, a stereotype rather than a dictionary synonym.

clue.text: Suggestion — dodge barrier

parts.note: a ring is a suggestion or hint, as in a ring of truth
to fence is to parry or dodge, as in fencing with questions

explanation.surface: A suggestion to avoid a barrier.
explanation.definitionFit: A ring fence is literally an enclosing perimeter, an obstacle round a property.

clue.text: Try pancakes I cut — they're grotesque

parts.note: to have a go is to have a try

indicators.note: cut means the letter I is removed

parts.note: blinis are small Russian buckwheat pancakes

explanation.surface: Someone attempts pancakes and slices them, finding them grotesque.
explanation.walkthrough: BLINIS loses an I to give BLINS.
explanation.definitionFit: Goblins are ugly mischievous creatures of folklore, grotesque in appearance.

clue.text: Emperor not happy about dance

parts.note: a czar was a Russian emperor

indicators.note: about means turned around, so the word reads backwards

parts.note: sad means not happy

explanation.surface: An unhappy emperor concerns himself with a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns SAD into DAS.
explanation.definitionFit: The czardas is a Hungarian folk dance that speeds up from slow to fast.

clue.text: Network time given to kids

parts.note: issue means offspring or children

explanation.surface: Broadcast airtime set aside for children.
explanation.definitionFit: Tissue is a web or interwoven mass, as in a tissue of lies, so a network.

clue.text: Hedge, one close to one bearing nuts?

parts.note: to hedge or stall is to evade or play for time
I is the Roman numeral for one
on means near or close to, as in a house on the river

explanation.surface: A hedge with one plant near a nut tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hedge' is a verb, to stall. The definition plays on nuts as slang for testicles, not tree fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: An uncastrated male horse keeps its testicles, slang 'nuts', unlike a gelding.

clue.text: Animal in ancient times aboard ark

indicators.note: aboard means placed on the vessel, so these letters go inside

parts.note: an ark is a boat, like Noah's
BC, before Christ, marks ancient dates

explanation.surface: An animal in the ancient past aboard Noah's ark.
explanation.definitionFit: The bobcat is a North American wild cat, a type of lynx.

clue.text: Picked up a dear bachelor, camp at heart, swinging either way

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for bachelor, as in degrees

indicators.note: at heart points to the middle letters of camp

parts.note: swinging either way is slang for bisexual, shortened to bi

explanation.surface: A bachelor, camp at heart and bisexual, got off with a dear.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on sound: 'a dear' heard is 'a deer'. Note too the answer reads the same either way.
explanation.definitionFit: Bambi is the young deer of the Disney film, matching the heard phrase 'a deer'.

clue.text: Guardian clues go in, cracked by lunch hour

indicators.note: cracked means broken apart, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: one o'clock is a lunch hour, and one is I in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Guardian crossword clues get solved over the lunch break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Guardian' looks like the newspaper but is the definition; 'cracked' rearranges CLUES GO IN to GENIUSLOC, and I is added.
explanation.definitionFit: In Roman belief the spirit protecting a particular place was its guardian deity.

clue.text: Produced Michael Jackson video games, sampled in a progressive fashion

indicators.note: sampled takes a single letter from each word in turn, starting with the first
in a continues the sampling, now taking the second letter of the next word along
progressive means each pick advances one place further into its word than the last
fashion completes the manner of picking, the fourth letter from the fourth word

explanation.surface: Michael Jackson's music videos sampled in modern style.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the 1st letter of Michael, 2nd of Jackson, 3rd of video and 4th of games.
explanation.definitionFit: Made is a past participle meaning produced or manufactured.

clue.text: Failing to start trickier manoeuvres by MI6, puffed up little things

indicators.note: manoeuvres means moved about, so these letters are rearranged
failing to start means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: MI6, the British foreign intelligence service, employs spies

explanation.surface: Trickier manoeuvres by British intelligence fail to start.
explanation.walkthrough: TRICKIER without its T leaves RICKIER, which 'manoeuvres' rearranges to RICEKRI.
explanation.definitionFit: The breakfast cereal consists of small grains of puffed rice.
